response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, mobile, embedded and high-throughput backend systems, plus a CS degree and genuine community/mentorship leadership — meeting the baseline experience and language requirements. However, the resume shows essentially no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical analysis. Career scope has been senior IC at small-to-mid companies rather than the multi-team, cross-org architectural leadership expected at Principal/IC6, and there is no demonstrated track record of owning growth measurement or systemic platforms adopted by many teams. Strong generalist, but a poor match for this specialized role.
strengths: 15+ years across full stack, embedded, and high-throughput low-latency services (Sociomantic/dunnhumby)
Deep testing/quality craftsmanship — TDD, CI/CD, authored test runner and assertion libraries
Recent AI-agent tooling and MCP work aligns with the 'AI-first' and AI-velocity preference
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or rollout-risk experience shown
No telemetry/metrics platform or statistical/data-analysis background evidenced
Scope reads as senior IC at small orgs, not Principal-level cross-team platform ownership

key_factors.factor: Insufficient Principal-level cross-org technical leadership evidence
Long tenure of strong general engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
